description: Composite figure of two different plot types, illustrating the prediction performance of machine-learning yield-strength (YS) models for medium-manganese low-density steels. Panel (c) is a bar chart titled "R² Comparison" with y-axis "R²" scaled 0.0–1.0 in 0.2 steps; two bars carry printed data labels — red "Extra Trees" = 0.978 and blue "GA-Extra Trees" = 0.997 — so the GA-optimised model has the higher coefficient of determination. The second panel (its panel letter is cropped out of the supplied image) is a line plot of Value versus Sample: the y-axis "Value" runs 0–3000 in 500 steps and the x-axis "Sample" runs 0–120 in 20 steps; an in-panel legend distinguishes "Actual YS" (dark line) from "Predicted YS" (red line). The red predicted curve closely tracks the dark actual curve over all ~120 samples, reproducing the same very tall peaks (approaching the 2500–3000 region near samples ~28, ~45 and ~115) and the same low troughs (near 100–200), with only small local deviations. Together the panels argue that the GA-Extra Trees model reproduces per-sample yield strength almost exactly, consistent with its near-unity R².
measured_quantities: yield strength value (axis labelled 'Value', no unit printed)

observations.observation: The bar chart is titled 'R² Comparison' and plots only two bars, one red and one blue.
The printed data label above the red 'Extra Trees' bar is 0.978 and above the blue 'GA-Extra Trees' bar is 0.997.
The bar-chart y-axis is labelled 'R²' with ticks at 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8 and 1.0; there is no x-axis title beyond the two category names.
The bar chart carries the panel letter '(c)', implying the figure group originally had at least three panels (a)-(c).
The line-plot y-axis is labelled 'Value' with ticks 0, 500, 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500, 3000; the x-axis is labelled 'Sample' with ticks 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, 120.
The line-plot legend contains exactly two entries: 'Actual YS' (dark grey/black line) and 'Predicted YS' (red line).
The predicted YS curve overlaps the actual YS curve almost everywhere, so the two lines are visually hard to separate at most samples.
Both curves show sharp maxima approaching the 2500-3000 band at roughly samples 28, 45 and 115, and minima falling near 100-200 around samples 60-70.
The predicted curve appears to overshoot the actual peak near sample 45 (the predicted line rises above the dark line there).
The line-plot y-axis unit is not printed; the quantity is labelled only as 'Value', although the legend identifies it as yield strength (YS).
The caption describes the figure as an 'Effect chart of model prediction'.
The citing text states the findings demonstrate a significant enhancement in the model's performance.

subfigures.description: Bar chart titled 'R² Comparison'. Y-axis 'R²' from 0.0 to 1.0 (0.2 steps). Two bars with printed values: red 'Extra Trees' = 0.978 and blue 'GA-Extra Trees' = 0.997. Panel letter '(c)' appears at the top-left inside the axes.

Line plot of predicted vs actual yield strength: y-axis 'Value' 0-3000 (500 steps), x-axis 'Sample' 0-120 (20 steps). Legend inside top-left: 'Actual YS' (dark line) and 'Predicted YS' (red line). The two curves overlap closely across the whole sample range.
